acceptance.behavior: After the fix, `Player.drink_potion()` never leaves hp > max_hp (seeded defect arcade-d1: `self.hp = self.hp + POTION_HEAL` with no clamp).
`fixture-arcade fight --seed 1 --battles 10` shows no hp/max_hp line where hp > max_hp.
A regression test exists that would fail on the unclamped code and passes now.
Healing below max still works (a potion at hp=10 raises hp; the fix is a clamp, not a no-op).

adjudication: Run the seed-1 gauntlet and grep the log. a4 guards against the lazy fix (disabling potions entirely).
